ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: On the left side of the figure is triangle RSV, vertex R is on the left, S is in the upper middle, V is in the lower middle, and side RS is labeled 2y - 1. On the right side is triangle TVS, vertex T is on the right, the base VT from V to T is labeled 24, and the slanted side from S to T is labeled 24.5. The two triangles share segment SV. Reasoning: It is known that △RSV ≅ △TVS. According to the vertex order of the congruence statement, the correspondences are: R ↔ T, S ↔ V, V ↔ S. Therefore side RS corresponds to side TV. From corresponding sides being equal, we get 2y - 1 = 24. Solving gives 2y = 25, so y = 12.5.
